diagnostic.example_product_name: Queso lonchas fundido burger mezcla Hacendado
diagnostic.finding: Whole-package OCR can place ingredient prose beginning with Proteínas before the nutrition row, causing an additive E-number to be read as protein; PP-OCRv6 can also linearise carbohydrate/protein values immediately before their row labels.
diagnostic.action: Regression tests added first; parser hardened in commit c699ddb6de15e290a58410dc0251ad7147179148. A fresh end-to-end pilot rerun is required before any newly recovered value is accepted.
